question: How can I create a sticky sidebar that displays API code snippets on the right side of my documentation page?
ground_truth: You can use the `<Aside>` component to create a sticky container that floats content to the right of your page. Simply wrap your content, such as API snippets or code examples, inside the `<Aside>` tags. For example, to display an endpoint request snippet, you would use: `<Aside><EndpointRequestSnippet endpoint='POST /chat/{{domain}}' /></Aside>`.
